blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Sociable weavers are little birds that build one enormous nest from dry grass. Inside, each family has its own little room. The nest keeps the birds cool on hot days and warm on cold nights.

items.q: How do the birds build their nest?
items.model: They collect long pieces of dry grass and carry them in their beaks. They fly back to the tree and push the grass into the nest.

items.q: What do the parents feed their babies?
items.model: They bring them insects to eat.

items.q: Why is the giant nest a clever home?
items.model: Inside, it can be cooler when the sun is hot in the daytime. At night, the thick grass helps keep the birds warm.

items.q: Would you like to live in a big building with many families? Why or why not?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the ideas in the order of the text.
items: The birds collect long pieces of dry grass
They push the grass into their nest
The parents bring insects to the hungry babies
Some birds fix old parts of the nest
At night, the thick grass keeps the birds warm
